metadata.description: Session 87 feature inventory with Core/Content/Utility sequence and v36-v40 upgrades.

features.name: Shared DLL contracts and enums
features.description: SharedProtocol.dll and GameCommon.dll provide packet contracts, queue policy helpers, and world-map signatures.

features.name: Hydrology signature v36 and map-control profile v40
features.description: Server/client generation profile synchronization upgraded to v36 signature and v40 profile version.

features.name: Shared distance-priority queue policy
features.description: Queue policy adds deterministic distance-priority ordering with duplicate suppression.

features.name: Server world-map chunk update prioritization
features.description: Server map control manager prioritizes chunk update requests around player chunk and updates player position snapshots.

features.name: Client queue drain prioritization
features.description: Unity world-map controller reorders queued requests by player distance during overload drain.

features.name: JSON runtime queue configuration
features.description: Server/client queue thresholds and backoff values are tuned via shared JSON policies.

features.name: Hydrology-aware cave lithified roof bridge
features.description: Cave generation adds lithified roof stability sealing for wet/thin roof zones near riparian terrain.

features.name: Hydrology-aware river floodplain retention anchor
features.description: River generation adds floodplain retention anchor bridge to reduce channel cutoff under queue pressure and terrain slope variance.

features.name: Hydrology-aware lake spillway retention anchor
features.description: Lake generation adds spillway retention anchor to stabilize outflow continuity under floodplain transitions.

features.name: Integrated terrain pipeline usage
features.description: Enhanced terrain pipeline applies cave/river/lake bridges through improved generation stages.

features.name: Protocol message-set partition guard
features.description: Protocol validator now checks required/optional set overlap and duplicate required bindings.

features.name: Protobuf descriptor/fingerprint verification
features.description: Fingerprint validation, registry diagnostics, and proto-source freshness checks are executed in CI/session runs.

features.name: Dummy client packet round-trip probe
features.description: Dummy clients validate required packet round-trip and optional packet prototype gaps with explicit diagnostics.

features.name: Compile-time reference integrity
features.description: Build/test passes validate that using-referenced classes and projects resolve correctly.
